'''2011 Worlds Day 2 Mike Kessling LS Plead My Case To The Senate''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Mike Kessling]] at [[2011 World Championship]] (Day 2).

Deck name '''my Back'''. Username '''Kessling'''. Sheet back written Flip → Sanity And Compassion. L26 Leia Skywalker (V) → Daughter Of Skywalker (V). L27 Liann Mena → Liana Merian. L28–30 Harek Ryyder → Horox Ryyder. L44 Insurrection → Insurrection & Aim High. L50 HOTS → Honor Of The Jedi. L55 Aquaris as written.

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' [[Plead My Case To The Senate / Sanity And Compassion]]
* '''Username:''' Kessling
* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 2
